articles.title: EU risks Donald Trump backlash with $1bn fine on Google
articles.description: The European Union (EU) has imposed another big fine on a US tech giant in defiance of warnings of reprisals from Donald Trump. Its investigation found Google gave more prominence to its own services, including shipping and hotels, in Google Search results.
